audit.whatIsWrong: Chart marks Levels 3 and 6 as 'Skill' and gives Darius the two-item stage, while whys[6] and content.late both say Garen takes over at two-plus items.
audit.why: Garen has no dash, so at 3 Apprehend traps him — that is a Darius stage, not a coinflip. At 6 an even-health all-in beats Demacian Justice (120s at rank 1), which the entry already says. At two-plus items his bruiser stats, Courage damage reduction and the R execute flip it, as the same entry states.
audit.corrected: Darius / Darius / Darius / Darius / Darius / Darius / Garen in both layers.
sources: internal contradiction with whys[6] and content.late

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 stage text is corrupted: 'Noxian Guillotine deals true damage R = d + a \times Stacks, bypassing defensive items completely.'
audit.why: A LaTeX formula fragment shipped into player-facing copy. Noxian Guillotine is 120/100/80s, deals true damage scaled by Hemorrhage stacks, and refreshes on a kill.
audit.corrected: Rewritten as plain advice naming the true damage, the stack scaling and the kill refresh.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere says Decisive Strike breaks slows.
audit.why: Riot's text: Decisive Strike gives a burst of Move Speed 'breaking free of all slows affecting him', on a flat 8s cooldown, and silences on the follow-up attack. Darius sticks to targets with Crippling Strike and Apprehend slows, so Garen's Q is both his escape from your slow and the silence that denies your Apprehend and Noxian Guillotine casts. That is the decisive interaction of the lane and it is absent.
audit.corrected: Stated in spikes[0], early and wants.foe[0]: bait the 8s Decisive Strike before you commit slows or the pull.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.trading contains an extracted page header: 'Darius Top Lane Matchup Database 72' and stray bullet glyphs.
audit.why: PDF extraction artifact left in live copy.
audit.corrected: Removed, replaced with the Courage bait rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.carry says 'Carry threat: 7.5/10' and breakdown.difficulty says 'Overall difficulty: 7.5/10' while carryRating is 6/10 and diffRating is 5.5/10.
audit.why: Same entry disagrees with itself; the report section prints the 6/10 and 5.5/10 figures.

edits.before: Full basic kits unlocked on both sides; spacing out displacements determines the winner. Keep the wave near your tower so Garen has to walk into pull range.
edits.after: Full kit online and Garen owns no dash, so Apprehend traps him inside Decimate range. Keep the wave near your tower so Garen has to walk into pull range.

edits.before: Noxian Guillotine deals true damage R = d + a \times Stacks, bypassing defensive items completely. The execute resets on takedowns — all-in windows are now real kill windows.
edits.after: Noxian Guillotine is true damage scaled by Hemorrhage stacks, so his Courage resists do nothing. The execute refreshes on takedowns — all-in windows are now real kill windows.

edits.before: You stay a side-lane terror but fall off vs grouped teams. Look for flank pulls in fights; one reset chain can win the game.
edits.after: Courage soaks your bleed and Demacian Justice executes you once chunked. Flank for pulls; one reset chain still wins games.

edits.before: Carry threat: 7.5/10. If Garen gets ahead, shift from winning trades to wave control, vision, and playing with your jungler.
edits.after: Carry threat: 6/10. If Garen gets ahead, shift from winning trades to wave control, vision, and playing with your jungler.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 7.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Courage and how disciplined your trade windows are.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 5.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Courage and how disciplined your trade windows are.

edits.before: Good trade: Look for them to walk forward to secure a critical minion last hit. Step up instantly, land an auto-attack directly into a fast Crippling Strike (W) reset, and use the heavy slow to step back out of their counter-abilities. If they panic and waste their primary mobility or crowd control tool, activate Ghost immediately, pull them back with Apprehend, and stack your passive to full for an easy execution loop. • • Darius Top Lane Matchup Database 72 Bad trade: Whiffing Apprehend and then fighting anyway — without the pull you have no engage, and chasing through a wave bleeds you dry.
edits.after: Good trade: Look for him to walk forward to secure a critical minion last hit. Step up instantly, land an auto-attack directly into a fast Crippling Strike (W) reset, and use the heavy slow to step back out of Judgment. If he panics and burns Decisive Strike, its 8-second cooldown is your window: Ghost, pull him back with Apprehend, and stack Hemorrhage to five for the execute. Great trade: catching him with Decisive Strike spent — slow-break and silence both gone, so the pull and five stacks land. Bad trade: Whiffing Apprehend and then fighting anyway — without the pull you have no engage, and chasing through a wave bleeds you dry.

edits.before: Garen's trade is his silence-Q into E spin, but he has no gap-closer once you're on him. E-pull him as he Q-engages, W-slow to hold him in your Q, and land the outer edge to heal and stack Hemorrhage — your bleed out-damages his spin at these levels.
edits.after: Garen's trade is Decisive Strike into Judgment, and that Q also breaks every slow on him — your W and E cannot hold him while it is up. Bait it, then E-pull during its 8-second cooldown, W-slow, and land the outer Q edge to heal and stack Hemorrhage.

edits.before: Silence your pull with Q and spin you down
edits.after: Break your slow and silence you with Q

edits.before: Levels 1-4 are firmly yours. Garen has no dash, so once you E-pull and W-slow him he's stuck in your Q range, and your Hemorrhage bleed beats his E spin damage in any extended trade. Land outer-Q heals, deny his farm, and keep him out of his passive-regen comfort zone.
edits.after: Levels 1-4 are firmly yours, with one rule: Decisive Strike breaks all slows and silences you, so it answers both your W slow and your Apprehend. Bait it, commit inside its 8-second cooldown, and a dashless Garen is stuck in Decimate range while Hemorrhage out-damages his spin.
